notes: How the players upgrade the game: any VersionedEntry (rule, effect, skill, class, creature, item, protocol parameter) can receive a proposal version on a Radicle branch; signed votes accumulate weight; a deterministic rebalance script measures the proposal and counter-proposes linked deltas within a tolerance; on success the branch merges to develop and clients load the new canonical version at their next session. Parameters here are themselves VersionedEntries so the governance can govern itself.

versions.notes: Supersedes the prose in schema.json sync_contract.radicle_branch_layout; schema.json now points here.

main.writes: merge from develop by the release script only

develop.content: accepted proposals waiting for the next release
develop.writes: merge from proposals/* by the tally script when governance_voting thresholds pass

proposals/<entry_id>-<unix_ts>.content: one new version object appended to exactly one entry (or one linked set produced by the rebalance script)
proposals/<entry_id>-<unix_ts>.writes: proposer + rebalance script counter-proposals + vote_log appends

forks/<fork_name>.content: a group's larger rule-set divergence (own data/ tree)
forks/<fork_name>.writes: fork owners; may open a proposals/* branch to merge back wholesale

release.step: tag data/ on main as data-vX.Y.Z; clients compare rules_snapshot_commit at session open and prompt to update; a running Dimension keeps its snapshot until it is closed or its owners vote to migrate

file_rules: never edit a version object in place; append a new version with parent_version set
ids are never reused; a removed entry becomes status rejected with weight 0
proposals touch one entry unless produced by the rebalance script, which may touch the rebalance_links closure

versions.notes: Weight is the consensus confidence in a version, in [0,1]. The engine loads the highest-weight non-rejected version of each entry at session start.

data.who_may_vote: any peer with a signing key; weight of a vote scales with proven use of the entry (usage_evidence in evt_vote) so people who actually play with an effect/class decide its fate
data.vote_weight_formula: w = base(0.01) * (1 + log2(1 + times_used_in_dimension)) * (1 + 0.1 * dimensions_played_in); capped at 0.10 per peer per proposal

proposal_lifecycle.enter: branch created with new version object at weight 0.0

proposal_lifecycle.during: vote_log appends; weight = clamp(sum(+1 w) - sum(-1 w), 0, 1); rebalance script may append counter-proposal versions

proposal_lifecycle.enter: at tally time weight >= accept_threshold AND distinct voters >= quorum AND age >= min_age_s AND rebalance_within_tolerance
at tally time weight <= reject_threshold OR age > max_age_s without reaching quorum
automatically for the previous canonical version when a new one becomes canonical; its weight is set to the new version's weight minus 0.01 so it remains the fallback

data.in_dimension_voting: votes cast inside an owned Dimension apply immediately to that Dimension's local snapshot if its owners agree (local override), and are forwarded as evt_vote to the global proposal; the rebalance script may counter-propose and the local override is replaced if the owners accept within tolerance
data.vote_integrity: each vote is a signed hashgraph event; the tally script rejects duplicates per (peer_id, entry_id, version) and votes whose usage_evidence is not backed by TurnCommit history

versions.notes: The author's intent: no class, skill or effect becomes too strong; a buff to one thing is paid for by respective changes elsewhere, or a nerf comes with a compensating property. The script is deterministic so every peer can re-run it and verify the counter-proposal.

power_score.effect: expected_damage_per_action(rule_21 formula over the 12 characters' stat spreads) + 0.5*num_effect_types + 0.25*permanent_bonus + 0.5*channeling + 1.0*every_bonus(∀) - 0.3*element_cost_count

tolerance.explanation: a proposal passes if its power_score stays within 15% of the pre-proposal score OR the linked counter-deltas bring the mean of the rebalance_links closure back within 5%

counter_proposal_algorithm: else walk rebalance_links (breadth-first, depth <= 2) and distribute -delta proportionally to each linked entry's current power_score, producing a new version per linked entry with origin rebalance_script and parent_version = their canonical

if the proposal is a nerf (delta < 0) prefer adding a compensating property on the same entry (e.g. extra every_bonus, lower element_cost) over touching linked entries, when such a property keeps |delta| within tolerance
attach the counter-proposals to the same proposals/* branch; the original proposer may accept (vote +1 on the set) or amend
data.run_at: every tally_interval_s and on every new proposal push
data.transparency: the script writes rebalance_report.json next to the proposal with before/after power_score for every touched entry

entries.name: Forks and merging large changes back

data.create: forks/<name> starts as a copy of develop; Dimensions opened under a fork record rules_snapshot_commit from the fork and only players on that fork can join them
data.play: fork owners vote with the same rules inside their fork; their tally script runs against the fork tree
data.merge_back: a fork opens proposals/fork-<name>-<ts> containing the full diff; the global tally treats it as one proposal with accept_threshold of the strictest touched collection and quorum doubled
data.partial_merge: the rebalance script may split a fork proposal into per-entry proposals when the fork owners allow it (split_allowed flag on the branch)

versions.notes: Replaces the writes column previously hard-coded in index.json collections (kept there for display).

paper-only.policy: identity of the game; needs the concept-level thresholds (0.9 / 25 voters)

rebalance-only.policy: text may be amended only alongside a rebalance report

resolution-vote.policy: each entry lists proposed_resolutions; the winning resolution becomes a new version on the source entries
